articles.title: Hunter Biden’s LAPTOP blames bots after 98% crash as traders rack up six-figure losses
articles.snippet: The team said thin liquidity and automated traders distorted the launch, while Nansen data showed some early buyers sitting on six-figure losses after the memecoin’s debut.

articles.title: Hunter Biden denies profiting from memecoin after his LAPTOP crashes
articles.snippet: Nansen found a $117,800 unrealized loss in one wallet as the team announced liquidity incentives and Bubblemaps flagged fresh top holders.

articles.title: Hunter Biden’s laptop controversy gets a memecoin afterlife
articles.snippet: The project’s disclosures say LAPTOP has no utility, lock founder tokens for six months and reserve 2% for wallets that lost money on TRUMP.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Hunter Biden’s LAPTOP Crashes
articles.snippet: The meme coin plunged on its debut, as recent alt leaders and many onchain darlings slipped in a nasty day for crypto.

articles.title: What Is LAPTOP? Hunter Biden's Meme Coin Targeting TRUMP Holders
articles.snippet: The LAPTOP token launched on Base in September 2026, peaked two minutes later, and shed almost all of its value the same day.
